riley: Quickstart weirdness: followed Node and Python samples, Node returned 401 after a timeout/retry, Python returned immediate 403. both happened on "first call" flows.

riley: Node snippet: `const c = new Redwood(process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY); await c.generate({model:'redwood-1', input:'hi'})` -> timed out then 401.

cam: did you use the same workspace/key for both?

riley: yes. `redwood workspace status` shows billing: not_configured, access: hosted.

billing-bot: Automated: workspace ws_999 flagged as billing_required. Hosted API calls blocked until billing method linked.

cam: that explains it. SDK parity bug: Node retries once on network timeout and then surfaces 401; Python treats auth as immediate 4xx and doesn't retry. causes confusing onboarding logs.

riley: unblocked after linking card, curl worked and first call succeeded :party_parrot: but we should make quickstart surface billing state earlier.

cam: filed devex ticket to (1) show billing status in npx quickstart, (2) standardize SDK retry behavior so billing-related 4xx are terminal and logged clearly. GH: https://github.com/redwood-inference/devex/issues/451

devex-bot: Note: Action items added to sprint - quickstart UX and SDK retry parity for billing/auth errors.
